## Current appointment

**Ezra Systems Postdoctoral Associate**<br>
Systems Engineering Program<br>
Cornell University, Ithaca, New York

I work with **Professor Fengqi You** on AI for materials processing, where neural operators model distributed process dynamics for control and constrained optimization.
